name: Code Repository Manager
description: Injects configured Git repositories as Agent documents and exposes tools for preparing Git and cloning repositories into the workspace.

capabilities.name: code-repositories.md
capabilities.description: Exposes configured repository metadata to the Agent document index.

capabilities.name: code_repository_manager_prepare_git
capabilities.description: Checks that Git CLI and configured repository credentials are available.

capabilities.name: code_repository_manager_ensure_repository
capabilities.description: Clones or fetches a configured repository into the Agent workspace.
